english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something that is not expensive and is reasonably affordable.
Use this when the point is that a price is not high, rather than that it is fair or justified.

examples.english: The food at this cha chaan teng is affordable.
examples.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 caa4 gei3 di1 je5 m4 gwai3

examples.english: This shirt isn't expensive, so it's reasonable to buy it.
examples.jyutping: ni1 gin6 saam1 m4 gwai3 maai5 laa1
